evidenceRules: Reference sanitized local files only. Do not include tokens, passwords, storage contents, private reasons or scene source. Prefilled fixture versions/counts identify intended checks, not observed runs; verify them against each exported report. Record each fixture's own schema/version separately from this release-record schema. Keep prior-build reports and user-reported results in historicalEvidence with original scope, artifacts and missing metadata. PASS requires observations for the named current artifacts and actual browser/device; PARTIAL, FAIL, UNSUPPORTED and NOT_RUN remain incomplete. NOT_APPLICABLE requires a reason and cannot silently remove a requested platform. Historical window-thread probes do not establish current worker behavior; an 11-check fixed-worker-1 report does not establish network/storage/canary coverage. Distinguish actual compiler-worker attempts from the fixed observation worker's CSP results. Only the recovery group with current-renderer-recovery scope is current in fixed-security-3; boundary/failures/stall remain historical. Local, emulated or fixed-sample results cannot be promoted to untested deployed/device or normal-app coverage.
